prompt:
Generate one original photorealistic lifestyle photograph of a fictional 27-year-old adult woman.

FRAMING: From the top of her hair to her upper thighs, with her entire face visible. A close, casually composed smartphone photo.

SUBJECT: A fictional 27-year-old adult woman with a distinctive, attractive face and believable adult proportions. Soft angular cheekbones, a slightly broad natural nose, hazel-green almond eyes, full lips with fine natural creases, and subtly uneven brows. Preserve small differences between the two sides of her face. Warm light olive complexion, a few irregular freckles across her nose and upper cheeks, faint redness around the nostrils, subtle under-eye texture and tiny pores at normal photographic scale. A light natural sheen on the nose and cheekbones; cheeks remain mostly matte. Collarbone-length dark auburn hair with loose, imperfect waves and an off-center part. One side is tucked behind an ear; a few fine flyaways catch the window light. Light brown mascara, softly brushed brows, muted rose blush and a thin layer of rosy lip balm. Skin texture remains visible. Direct, relaxed eye contact with the lens and a slight, asymmetric closed-mouth smile. Confident and flirtatious, as if she knows the person taking the photo.

WARDROBE: An opaque deep burgundy satin camisole with thin straps and a softly draped low cowl neckline. Fitted through the waist, with natural folds and complete chest coverage. The neckline and bare shoulders give the outfit a sensual eveningwear feel. Pale blue relaxed jeans sitting naturally on the hips, with visible denim grain, belt loops and ordinary creases at the waistband. Small gold hoop earrings and a single fine gold chain resting naturally against her skin. Satin catches broad, soft reflections along real folds. Strap tension, seams and contact shadows follow the body. No fabric painted onto the skin.

SCENE: A small, lived-in Lisbon apartment kitchen with pale sage cabinet doors, an off-white plaster wall and a worn cream stone counter beside a tall open window. A simple ceramic espresso cup and a folded linen towel sit on the counter. A few distant terracotta rooftops are visible through the window. Background objects remain recognizable and slightly softer than her face. A quiet late-afternoon moment before going out. Attractive, personal and casual, with the understated spontaneity of a creator's camera roll.

POSE AND COMPOSITION: She stands beside the counter with her torso turned about 35 degrees away from the camera, then turns her head back toward the lens. Her weight rests on the leg nearer the counter. Shoulders stay loose. Her nearer hand rests lightly on the counter with relaxed, naturally separated fingers. Her other hand is casually tucked into the front pocket of her jeans, with only the thumb visible. The photo is taken by another person from approximately 1.3 meters away, with the phone just below her eye line and tilted very slightly downward. This is a direct photograph, without a mirror or a visible phone. Her face sits slightly to the right of center, with a little breathing room above her hair. The counter creates a quiet diagonal in the lower-left area. Her face is the primary point of attention. A comfortable sideways lean against the counter, slight head turn and unforced confidence. Keep the posture physically relaxed.

LIGHTING: One large window just outside the frame on camera-left provides soft directional daylight. The room lights are off. Late-afternoon warmth touches the hair and shoulder nearest the window. Light falls gently across the face, with a soft cheek shadow on the opposite side and subtle ambient fill from the pale wall. Eye catchlights, skin highlights, jewelry reflections, satin sheen and object shadows all agree with the same window position. Expose for natural skin tones. Preserve a little brightness in the window, gentle shadow depth and realistic color differences between skin, satin and plaster.

CAMERA RENDERING: A recent smartphone's main camera at roughly a 35mm-equivalent crop. Natural facial perspective, normal photo mode and moderately deep focus. Eyes and eyelashes are crisply resolved, with plausible detail falloff across the hair, clothing and background. No artificial portrait-mode cutout. Restrained smartphone sharpening and dynamic range. Very fine sensor noise in darker areas, believable tonal transitions and neutral-warm white balance. Texture should become apparent on closer inspection. Avoid exaggerating every pore, freckle or fabric fiber.

PRIORITIES: A believable adult face, gaze and relaxed expression. Physically consistent daylight, anatomy and materials. A sensual, fully clothed fashion portrait with an everyday UGC feel. Small natural imperfections and an unforced composition.

AVOID: Plastic or waxy skin, aggressive beauty filters, uniformly glossy skin. Overdrawn pores, oversharpened hair, identical repeated freckles. Perfect facial symmetry, doll-like eyes, inflated lips or exaggerated body proportions. Rigid posing, pronounced back arch, exaggerated pout. Transparent clothing, exposed nipples or nudity. Extra fingers, fused fingers, twisted wrists or inconsistent limb positions. Floating jewelry, straps merging into skin, impossible satin folds. Studio lighting, ring-light catchlights, cinematic color grading or extreme background blur. Mirrors, visible phones, duplicate people, text, logos, watermarks or social-media interface elements.

Create the single finished photograph. Favor convincing human presence and ordinary photographic plausibility over a polished advertising look. The result should feel like an unusually good casual phone photo of this fictional adult woman.
